name: syncteam-cli
description: CLI standalone do SyncTeam (instala o plugin de Roblox Studio, entre outros comandos futuros), distribuído via Rokit.

scripts.build:assets: bun run build:plugin-asset && bun run build:extension-asset
scripts.package:win-x64: bun run compile:win-x64 && bun run scripts/zip-release.ts windows-x86_64
scripts.package:macos-x64: bun run compile:macos-x64 && bun run scripts/zip-release.ts macos-x86_64
scripts.package:macos-arm64: bun run compile:macos-arm64 && bun run scripts/zip-release.ts macos-aarch64
scripts.package:all: bun run package:win-x64 && bun run package:macos-x64 && bun run package:macos-arm64
